name: Blue Owl Capital
notable_deals: Acquired the entire asset-management business of IPI Partners (~$1.0B, ~80% Blue Owl stock / 20% cash) via its Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure (BODI) platform -- announced Oct 7, 2024, closed Jan 6, 2025 -- adding ~$10.5B AUM including IPI's portfolio companies STACK Infrastructure and RadiusDC. STACK is now routinely described in press as a Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure portfolio company (e.g. an Aug 2026 Virginia land deal reported as "Blue Owl's Stack Infrastructure"). Blue Owl also closed a $7B Digital Infrastructure Fund III (ODI III) around the same period.
notes: Added from web research into data center industry ownership, 2026-09-05. Verify against Siddhi's own research. STACK Infrastructure link added 2026-09-05 after Siddhi flagged it directly -- confirmed via Blue Owl's own press releases and an SEC 8-K exhibit re: the IPI Partners acquisition. See also the separate "IPI Partners" investor record for STACK's 2019-2024 founding sponsor (now absorbed into Blue Owl).
